rules.trigger: a successor validation round after terminal or pre-response stop
rules.requiredBehavior: preserve Rounds 2 and 3 and forbid new prompts under either identity
rules.failureCondition: resuming, rewriting, or interpreting either historical round as Round-4 validation
rules.enforcement: source-bound historical dispositions and separate Round-4 namespace

rules.trigger: browser or CDP loss after Send may have occurred
rules.requiredBehavior: recover only an exact full-text-hash-matching existing submission and never resend automatically
rules.failureCondition: blind resend or identity by timing/title/order
rules.enforcement: send-intent, SENT receipt, exact-one recovery candidate, whole-study stop

rules.requiredBehavior: reuse the dedicated supervised Round-3 profile/display/browser/watchdog independent of XRDP
rules.failureCondition: ad-hoc interactive browser dependency or unverified runtime drift
rules.enforcement: hash-bound systemd units, wrappers, process command line, deterministic pre-Send tests, and live normal-path acceptance

rules.requiredBehavior: use focused tests in the inner loop and run unchanged full gates once at freeze
rules.failureCondition: redundant unchanged inference or deterministic reruns

rules.requiredBehavior: continue through generation, judging, scoring, and final disposition
rules.failureCondition: claiming implementation or CI completes the study
rules.enforcement: active task owner gap and finalizer
